vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
降低目标护甲
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
攻击造成额外倍数伤害；有概率触发或强化下一次攻击都算
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
目标无法普通攻击
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
提供额外金钱或经验；只是正常赏金不算
目标低于生命阈值时直接杀死
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法或技能伤害
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
攻击无视闪避（必中）
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
降低自身受到的减速效果（如散夜对剑+30%）
提高技能造成的伤害
把指向技能反弹给施法者
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
召唤有血量的单位（可控或不可控都算），以及夺取已有单位的控制权；按受攻击次数计算的单位和死亡守卫不算

objects.subject: heart
objects.description_en: Passive: Behemoth's Blood Your health regeneration is increased by %missing_health_regen%%% of your missing health.
notes_en: Multiple instances of Behemoth's Blood do not stack.

objects.subject: heavens_halberd
objects.description_en: Active: Disarm Prevents a target from attacking for %disarm_melee% seconds.

objects.subject: helm_of_the_dominator
objects.description_en: Active: Dominate Takes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit and sets its movement speed to %speed_base% and max health to a minimum of %health_min%. Also provides the unit with +%creep_bonus_damage% base attack damage, +%creep_bonus_hp_regen% health regen, +%creep_bonus_mp_regen% mana regen and +%creep_bonus_armor% armor.   Dominated units with a max health of greater than %health_min% retain their original max health. Grants the caster %bounty_pct%%% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to %bounty_gold% gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.  The Helm cannot be used for %creep_damage_taken_cooldown% seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Cannot dominate more than one unit at a time.  If a new unit is dominated, the old one will die.
Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling Helm of the Dominator will cause dominated units to die.

objects.subject: helm_of_the_overlord
objects.description_en: Active: Dominate Takes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to %speed_base% and max health to a minimum of %health_min%. Also provides the unit with +%creep_bonus_damage% base attack damage, +%creep_bonus_hp_regen% health regen, +%creep_bonus_mp_regen% mana regen, +%creep_bonus_armor% armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level.   Dominated units with a max health of greater than %health_min% retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to %bounty_gold% gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.  The Helm cannot be used for %creep_damage_taken_cooldown% seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling will cause dominated units to die.

objects.subject: holy_locket
objects.description_en: Active: Energy Charge Target an allied unit to increase their incoming Heal Amplification by %incoming_heal_increase_active%%% for %active_buff_duration%s and instantly restore %health_restore_per_charge% health and %mana_restore_per_charge% mana per charge stored.   Automatically gains a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime% seconds and whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.   Passive: Holy Blessing Amplifies heals you provide by %heal_increase_passive%%%.

objects.subject: hurricane_pike
objects.description_en: Active: Hurricane Thrust  Pushes you and target enemy %enemy_length% units away from each other, and for %range_duration% seconds, allows you to make %max_attacks% attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +%bonus_attack_speed% attack speed.  Can be cast on self or allies to push the target %push_length% units in the direction it is facing. Enemy Range: %cast_range_enemy%
notes_en: Self-cast will use Hurricane Pike on yourself.
Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

objects.subject: infused_raindrop
objects.description_en: Passive: Magical Damage Block  Consumes a charge to block %magic_damage_block% magic damage from damage instances over %min_damage% damage.   Comes with %initial_charges% charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.
notes_en: Uses at most one charge per damage instance.

objects.subject: invis_sword
objects.description_en: Active: Shadow Walk Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While Shadow Walk is active, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.    If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage on that attack.
notes_en: Has a %windwalk_fade_time% second fade time.
If the invisibility ends without attacking, the bonus damage is lost.

objects.subject: javelin
objects.description_en: Passive: Pierce Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.

objects.subject: lesser_crit
objects.description_en: Passive: Critical Strike Grants each attack a %crit_chance%%% chance to deal %crit_multiplier%%% damage.
notes_en: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.

objects.subject: lifesteal
objects.description_en: Passive: Lifesteal Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

objects.subject: lotus_orb
objects.description_en: Active: Echo Shell Applies a shield to the target unit for %active_duration% seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.  The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Echo Shell.

objects.subject: maelstrom
objects.description_en: Passive: Chain Lightning Grants a %chain_chance%%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

objects.subject: mage_slayer
objects.description_en: Passive: Mage Slayer Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing %dps% physical damage per second and causing them to do %spell_amp_debuff%%% less spell damage for %duration% seconds.

objects.subject: magic_stick
objects.description_en: Active: Energy Charge  Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.   Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
notes_en: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

objects.subject: magic_wand
objects.description_en: Active: Energy Charge Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.   Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
notes_en: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

objects.subject: manta
objects.description_en: Active: Mirror Image Creates %images_count% images of your hero that last %illusion_duration% seconds.   Melee images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_melee%%% damage, while Ranged images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%. Illusions take %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.   Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

objects.subject: mask_of_madness
objects.description_en: Active: Berserk Gives %berserk_bonus_attack_speed% attack speed, %berserk_bonus_movement_speed%%% / %berserk_bonus_movement_speed_melee%%% movement speed (ranged/melee), and %berserk_slow_resist%%%/%berserk_slow_resist_melee%%% slow resistance (ranged/melee), but reduces your armor by %berserk_armor_reduction% and silences you.  Lasts %berserk_duration% seconds.   Passive: Lifesteal Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

objects.subject: mekansm
objects.description_en: Active: Restore Restores %heal_amount% health to allied units in a %heal_radius% radius.   Passive: Mekansm Aura Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allied units in a %aura_radius% radius.
notes_en: Restore does not affect units that have been affected by Restore or Guardian Greaves Mend within Mekansm's cooldown.
Multiple instances of Mekansm Aura do not stack.

objects.subject: meteor_hammer
objects.description_en: Active: Meteor Hammer  CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a %impact_radius% AoE, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage over time to enemies units and buildings for %burn_duration% seconds. Non-building units are also slowed for %burn_slow%%% for the duration of the burn.   Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_buildings%  Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_buildings%   Non-Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_units%  Non-Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_units%   Channel Duration: %max_duration% seconds. Landing Time: %land_time% seconds.

objects.subject: mjollnir
objects.description_en: Active: Static Charge Places a charged shield on a target unit for %static_duration% seconds which has a %static_chance%%% chance to release a %static_damage% magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and %static_strikes% additional enemies.   Passive: Chain Lightning Grants a %chain_chance%%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
notes_en: Static Charge cannot trigger more than once per second.
Static Charge's shock deals magical damage centered on hero with the Static Charge. Static Charge's targets cannot be more than %static_seconary_radius% range away.
Static Charge procs will not bounce to heroes that are invisible or hidden by Fog of War.

objects.subject: monkey_king_bar
objects.description_en: Passive: Pierce Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.

objects.subject: moon_shard
objects.description_en: Use: Consume  Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain %consumed_bonus% attack speed and %consumed_bonus_night_vision% bonus night vision. Max 1 use.   Passive: Shade Sight Grants bonus night vision.
